<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Wiping out the <move(1,14,5)><color(5)>targets<ce()><marker(22,14,2,0)><marker(22,14,5,0)><marker(22,14,8,0)> deployed in the area is<move(2,14,5)><picture(55,30,7,0)><picture(56,30,14,0)><refer(30,7,14,2)><refer(30,14,14,8)> the<marker(20,12,1,0)><marker(20,11,4,0)> goal<marker(20,1,0,0)><marker(20,3,0,0)><marker(20,0,3,0)><marker(20,0,5,0)> of<marker(20,4,6,0)><marker(20,8,7,0)> this<marker(20,8,10,0)><marker(20,8,14,0)> operation.

<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>The force sending <move(1,6,7)>the distress signal<ce()><marker(3,6,7,0)> will also be <color(6)>supported<ce()>, to be <move(2,6,7)><marker(5,1,10,0)><marker(5,3,11,0)>safe. Do not let their <color(4)>mothership<ce()><picture(57,2,7,0)><refer(2,7,6,7)> be <marker(48,14,3,0)><marker(48,14,6,0)><marker(48,14,9,0)>taken down.
rows.notes: Source omits who supports; passive kept. "to be safe" for nen no tame.

rows.en: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>One more point of caution. A <color(6)>dangerous area<ce()><danger(1)> has been confirmed inside the operation zone.

<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Area-suppression <move(1,9,2)>weapons<ce()><marker(37,9,2,0)> have been confirmed <move(1,12,7)>in the area.<marker(37,12,7,0)> They are <move(1,9,12)>probably the cause.<marker(37,9,12,0)>

<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><move(1,4,13)>This <color(5)>weapon<ce()><marker(37,4,13,0)> seems able to deploy some kind of <book(7)>particle<move(2,9,12)><picture(58,2,14,0)><refer(2,14,4,13)> field<endbook()>.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>This <book(7)>particle field<endbook()> apparently <color(6)>damages any unit that enters it<ce()>, which makes it a very dangerous thing.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>The <book(7)>particle field<endbook()> will be shown on the radar, so please fight while keeping out of it.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>If this <color(5)>weapon<ce()> is <color(6)>destroyed<ce()>, I think the <book(7)>particle field<endbook()> can be <color(6)>lifted<ce()> too, so go ahead and destroy it.
<delpic(2,7,1)><enemylist()><operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Well then, I am counting on you.

uncertainties.issue: Source scatters 10 markers inside the word sakusen mokuhyou; placed between the English words "the goal of this operation" in the same order.
"Area-suppression weapons" for kyokuchi seiatsu-you no heiki: no locked term; Encyclopedia describes the unit only as a combat support weapon that deploys a particle field.
move/picture/refer sit inside the book(7) span in the source; kept inside, between "particle" and "field".

glossary_proposals.why: Generic description of the particle-field emitter enemy.

meaning_fixes.before: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Area-suppression <move(1,9,2)>weapons<ce()><marker(37,9,2,0)> have been confirmed <move(1,12,7)>around it.<marker(37,12,7,0)> They are <move(1,9,12)>probably the cause.<marker(37,9,12,0)>
meaning_fixes.after: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Area-suppression <move(1,9,2)>weapons<ce()><marker(37,9,2,0)> have been confirmed <move(1,12,7)>in the area.<marker(37,12,7,0)> They are <move(1,9,12)>probably the cause.<marker(37,9,12,0)>
meaning_fixes.reason: Source says only "shuuhen ni wa" (in the vicinity), the same word the draft renders "in the area" in slot 20. "around it" invents a referent and says the weapons surround the danger area, while slots 24-25 say the weapons generate it.

checked_decisions: Slot 20 ruling: the ten markers are timing marks inside one source word; spreading them over "the goal of this operation" in source order is fine.
Slot 23 ruling: "Area-suppression weapons" is an accurate descriptive rendering of "kyokuchi seiatsu-you no heiki"; no locked term exists (Encyclopedia only describes the unit). Kept.
Slot 24 ruling: keeping move/picture/refer inside the <book(7)> span mirrors the source; correct.
Slot 21: passive "will also be supported" keeps the omitted subject; "mothership" matches meeting_briefing_015.
"particle field" matches mission_terms_019 and the Encyclopedia.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 23 plural "weapons" (three markers) vs slots 24/27 singular "This weapon" / "destroy it": the source has no number; left as is, but the player faces three emitters.
Slot 21: "force" for "seiryoku" could also be "faction"; left.
